*A series of [[5 April 2010 North-West Frontier Province attacks|coordinated bombings]] at the [[United States|U.S.]] [[Consul (representative)|consulate]] in [[Peshawar]] and at a ruling party rally in the [[Pakistan|Pakistani]] [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa|North-West Frontier Province]] kills fifty people and injures one hundred. *[[Upper Big Branch mine explosion|An explosion]] at a [[coal mine]] in [[Raleigh County, West Virginia|Raleigh County]], [[West Virginia]] kills 25 miners and leaves several missing. This is the deadliest mining accident in the U.S. in at least 35 years. *The [[Supreme Court of the United States|United States Supreme Court]] declines to take up a case by residents of [[Bikini Atoll]] and [[Enewetak]] in the [[Marshall Islands]], who are seeking [[payment|compensation]] for [[Marshall Islands#Nuclear tests after World War II|U.S. nuclear tests]] conducted on the islands. [http://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Justice/2010/0405/Supreme-Court-No-review-of-award-for-US-nuclear-weapons-tests (''Christian Science Monitor'')]
*[[Iraq War]]: [[WikiLeaks]] [[July 12, 2007, Baghdad airstrike|releases a video]] from 2007 showing the killing of civilians, including two [[Reuters]] news staff, by the [[United States armed forces|U.S. military]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]].
